notes.title: DLC3 'Martial Arts Tournament' of Slime Game is Now Out!
notes.content:
[h2]DLC3 [i]"Martial Arts Tournament"[/i] is now available! [b]Milim [/b]joins the game as a playable character![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44994302/842bc05bd937f63013d3e293f5568d3a7e2a9ac4.jpg[/img]

That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime ISEKAI Chronicles DLC 3 “Martial Arts Tournament',” is now available and Milim now joins the game as a playable character!

In DLC3, a new martial arts tournament is being held in Tempest, where players will have to win battles against various powerful opponents in order to arise victorious. Players can choose one of 12 characters to challenge and enjoy each character’s unique stories. The DLC also adds four new sub-quests and five new buildings for players to experience the base game’s “Tempest Story” on a deeper level.  

[h2]■DLC3 is now available to purchase and will include:[/h2]
[h3]Additional Scenario:  'Martial Arts Tournament' 
Playable Character: 'Milim'
Additional Side Quest: 4 Types 
Additional Building: 5 Types[/h3]

The game’s DLC packs are available for purchase and included for players who purchase the Digital Deluxe Edition or the Season Pass. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44994302/52c8c35ac57e3ea70c0443ea703fc8e461a3451d.jpg[/img]

[h2]Check out the new video introducing DLC3![/h2]

[previewyoutube=3bLlnToTZd0;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: DLC2 "The Fairy Queen’s Labyrinth" of Slime Console Game is Now Out!
notes.content:
[h2]DLC2 “The Fairy Queen’s Labyrinth” is now available! Veldora joins the game as a playable character![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44994302/e65fdc2c19be0fe0c2e72ac3f2982a292628d4f4.jpg[/img]

That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime ISEKAI Chronicles DLC 2 “The Fairy Queen’s Labyrinth,” is now available and Veldora now joins the game as a playable character!

The DLC also introduces a new mode where players can explore the original labyrinth built by Demon Lord Ramiris alongside the revived Veldora, pushing their limits as they take on a 100-level dungeon packed with formidable monsters. Additionally, the DLC includes five new sub-quests and seven new buildings for players to experience the base game’s “Tempest Story” on a deeper level. 

[h2][b]■DLC2 is now available to purchase and will include:[/b][/h2]
[h3]Additional Scenario: 'The Fairy Queen's Labyrinth' 
Playable Character: 'Veldora'
Additional Side Quest: 5 Types 
Additional Building: 7 Types[/h3]

The game’s DLC packs are available for purchase and included for players who purchase the Digital Deluxe Edition or the Season Pass.

notes.title: The First DLC "A Strange Fate" of Slime Console Game is Now Out!
notes.content:
[h2]First DLC “A Strange Fate” is now available! [b]Hinata [/b]joins the game as a playable character![/h2]

[previewyoutube=Ogf1TI8zZNM;full][/previewyoutube]

That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime ISEKAI Chronicles DLC 1 “A Strange Fate,” is now available. “A Strange Fate” is the first of three currently planned DLC releases for the title, with additional content coming later this year in September. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44994302/ba1a9621e5e88e0b95e89b95043ba191572e5904.jpg[/img]

The first-ever action RPG based on the multifaceted series will now allow players to go on a journey to find Hinata, Sumire’s childhood friend and captain of the Western Holy Church's Crusaders. In the “A Strange Fate” DLC, players will control Sumire instead of the titular character Rimuru. The DLC also adds ten new sub-quests and seven new buildings for players to experience the base game’s “Tempest Story” on a deeper level.  

[h2][b]■DLC1 is now available to purchase and will include:[/b][/h2]
[h3]Additional Scenario : A Strange Fate
Playable Character :Hinata
Additional Side Quest: 10 Types
Additional Buildings: 7 Types[/h3]

[h3]The game’s DLC packs are available for purchase and included for players who purchase the Digital Deluxe Edition or the Season Pass. [/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44994302/52c8c35ac57e3ea70c0443ea703fc8e461a3451d.jpg[/img]


[h2][b]Buy it now[/b][/h2]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2197680/

notes.content:

Thank you for your continued support of "That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime ISEKAI Chronicles."
